output.reason: The changelog line [ev-068257f2da0f] is vague, but the linked PR [ev-3881a5911482] spells out the change. It is a bug fix: every LifecyclerConfig constructor now uses `net.JoinHostPort` to combine the instance address and port, so IPv6 addresses work everywhere. Before, only distributors handled IPv6, because they use `Lifecycler`; the other components use `BasicLifecycler` and relied on the address/port combination built in their own config. The changed files [ev-87ec3af1d884] narrow the subject to ring instance-address handling in the distributor ring, the ruler ring and the common ring config. Exposed environments are those that run ring members on IPv6 instance addresses, and the outcome is a fix that needs no operator action, though the PR description is cut off.
